title: Exact and Evolutionary Algorithms for Sequential Multi-Objective Transmission Topology Planning
summary: We study day-ahead transmission topology control for high-voltage grid operation under $N-1$ security constraints. The operational task is to select, over a 24-hour horizon, a sequence of substation topologies obtained via busbar-coupler switching to relieve line overloads while limiting switching effort and topological complexity. We formulate this task as a sequential multi-objective optimization problem with four objectives used in TSO decision making: worst-case $N-1$ line loading, maximum topological depth, number of topology changes, and time spent outside the reference topology.
